headline: Not one adverse-event report has been filed for an AI medical device in South Korea since 2023, even though 382 such devices were approved, certified or notified, according to figures a lawmaker obtained from the regulator.
score_reason: Pool 6 kept: the figures were reported on 12 Oct 2026 and the article supports the story; it is one lawmaker's reading of ministry data and the 382 total is our own addition of the yearly figures.
importance_line: Ministry figures show fast-growing approvals of AI medical software with no recorded harm, which matters first to patients whose scans or diagnoses involve such software, then to hospitals and the regulator running the reporting system and to device makers; the figures cannot show whether no harm occurred or none was reported, the lawmaker suspects the reporting system is failing, and Yonhap carries no ministry response.
summary: Yonhap News Agency reports that figures South Korean lawmaker Heo Jong-sik of the Democratic Party obtained from the Ministry of Food and Drug Safety show approvals, certifications or notifications of AI medical software (programs that help read CT and MRI scans or assist diagnosis) rising from 62 in 2023 to 108 in 2024 and 157 in 2025, with 55 more in the first quarter of 2026 (382 in all, by our addition), while no adverse event (a harmful incident or side effect) involving an AI or digital medical device was reported from 2023 to June 2026, against 27 for new-technology medical devices as a whole. Heo, who sits on the National Assembly's health and welfare committee, said that because reporting is a legal duty, more than three years without a single report could be a sign that the system meant to catch software errors is not working, and he urged clearer standards for reporting software risks and checks that hospitals and companies actually report.
notes: Read in full in Korean (Yonhap, fulltext copy) and translated by the writer. url is the AMP page given in the pool, which is the page that was read. The 382 total is our sum of the yearly figures (62+108+157+55), not printed by Yonhap. Regional find with pool score 6; the event (12 Oct 2026) is inside the window, so the score is kept.
